Text:  
ABC company Italia S.p.A Rome Financial Services is seeking for a client company experiencing strong growth in the digital infrastructure sector:  

a Communication Specialist  

who will contribute to content creation, management of corporate communication channels, and event organization.  

Responsibilities:  
The candidate will mainly be responsible for the following activities:  

· Provide support in web design and management, creating and updating web page content dedicated to the company in collaboration with external partners (web agencies, technology partners, and system integrators)  

· Support the design and execution of an internal and external communication plan, monitoring its effectiveness  

· Measure the effectiveness of communication activities through analysis and reports on metrics such as engagement, web traffic, and event participation.  

· Manage the preparation of basic materials such as PowerPoint presentations or informational documents for meetings, gatherings, or small corporate events.  

· Prepare and send press releases, respond to journalists' inquiries, and manage relationships with local and national media.  

· Plan and support the organization of events, conferences, and seminars to promote the company's image and interact with clients and partners.  

· Contribute to defining and promoting the corporate image, ensuring that all messages are consistent and align with the corporate strategy.  

Requirements:  
The ideal candidate is someone who possesses:  

· At least 2/3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in corporate communication or marketing  

· A specialized degree in communication sciences or a first-level master's degree with a specialization in marketing and communication, preferably with a focus on digital channels  

· Good knowledge of the Office Suite  

· Good knowledge of the English language  

The profile is completed by:  

· Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with people at all corporate levels and express oneself clearly and professionally  

· Ability to create content in line with the corporate strategy

• Specific training and potential career development

Text:  
Sheet Metal Bending Department Operator
Job_post_eng:
Text: NEXTEEL is a captive company of the FAE Group, a world leader in the design and manufacturing of Forestry machines, Attachments, and tracked vehicles for soil treatment.
At the NEXTEEL production site, medium and heavy carpentry for FAE products is designed and manufactured through sheet metal cutting, bending, and welding processes – up to 20 mm thickness –, mechanical processes – automatic turning and milling – and painting. NEXTEEL is also a market reference for the cutting-edge technologies of the plant: it uses robotic lines and highly automated processes.
The work environment is dynamic, young, and rapidly growing.

The Role
SHEET METAL BENDING DEPARTMENT OPERATOR
In this role, you will be responsible for programming and using CNC sheet metal bending machines, particularly LVD machines. Among the tasks and activities:
• Bending sheets of different thicknesses and material qualities using CNC press brakes
• Machine setup and tooling based on production specifications
• Reporting work progress using barcode technology
• Performing quality checks during the bending process
• Ensuring safety and order at the workstation
• Collaborating with colleagues to optimize production processes.

Requirements
• Middle or High School Diploma
• Minimum experience of 2/3 years in the role of Sheet Metal Bending Operator
• Preferable knowledge and operational experience in programming and using LVD bending machines
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and work sheets
• Reliability, seriousness, and sense of responsibility
• Spirit of collaboration and cooperation
• Possible availability to work shifts (6-14/14-22).



Offer
• Safe and stimulating work environment
• Possibility of housing support for the first months of work
• Permanent contract
• Gross annual salary commensurate with actual experience plus production bonus
• Company canteen fully covered by the employer.



Availability: Shift availability without night

CCNL: Metalworking Industry

English
